business.description: Horizon Digital is a web design and development studio based on Mahé, Seychelles. We plan, design and build custom websites for local businesses.
business.positioning: Custom websites built around each business, its customers and its goals.

services.title: New website

services.title: Contact tools

serviceScopeBoundaries.title: Advice and implementation are separate
serviceScopeBoundaries.description: A consultation or review explains findings and priorities. Any hands-on implementation is agreed and scoped separately unless it is already part of a website package.

serviceScopeBoundaries.title: You keep ownership and control
serviceScopeBoundaries.description: Domains and business accounts should remain in the client's name. Work in a website or third-party account requires the necessary access and authority.

serviceScopeBoundaries.title: Existing providers can stay involved
serviceScopeBoundaries.description: If another provider manages the website, we can explain the requested work and coordinate agreed changes, subject to their process, cooperation and access.

serviceScopeBoundaries.title: Analytics needs an agreed privacy approach
serviceScopeBoundaries.description: The client is responsible for deciding the privacy and consent requirements that apply to the business. We can implement the agreed measurement setup when the required access and consent configuration are available; this is not legal advice.

serviceScopeBoundaries.title: Results are not guaranteed
serviceScopeBoundaries.description: Search rankings, traffic, enquiries, bookings, conversions and revenue depend on factors outside this work and are not guaranteed.

serviceScopeBoundaries.title: Google Ads management is not included
serviceScopeBoundaries.description: Google Ads campaign setup and ongoing advertising management are outside the services advertised here.

web.lead: We plan, design and build custom websites for Seychelles businesses, from focused new sites to larger rebuilds with deeper content or agreed integrations.

sections.title: A website should make the next step clear.
sections.body: Before design begins, we discuss your business, customers, services and goals. That gives the website a useful structure: what people need to understand, which pages support that decision and how they should contact you.
sections.note: Page count, functionality, content responsibilities and integrations are confirmed in the written scope.

sections.title: Build from the beginning or rethink what is already there.

items.title: New custom website
items.body: A new website starts with the business rather than a template. We agree the pages, content direction, contact paths and any suitable integrations, then prepare the visual direction for review before development begins.

items.title: Website redesign or rebuild
items.body: An existing website may need more than a visual refresh. We can reorganise content, improve mobile use and rebuild the experience around a clearer structure and current direction. The agreed scope determines what is retained, rewritten or replaced.

comparison.label: Starting point
comparison.caption: A basic structure that does not yet reflect the business.

comparison.label: Horizon Digital outcome
comparison.caption: A custom website with clearer information, a stronger visual direction and an obvious next step.

sections.title: The parts of a complete website project.
sections.intro: Packages define the standard page ranges, revisions and support periods. The written scope confirms the exact pages, responsibilities, functionality and any project-specific additions.

items.title: Structure and content direction
items.body: We plan the page hierarchy around the agreed services, audiences and goals. Messaging guidance is part of the process, and page content writing can be added where required.

items.title: Custom visual design and responsive development
items.body: The website receives a custom visual system and page layouts shaped around the business. We build and test the agreed experience across common phone, tablet and desktop sizes.

items.title: Contact paths and agreed integrations
items.body: Website packages include a contact form and WhatsApp link. Booking, enquiry, payment or other suitable integrations are agreed separately when the provider, access and project scope support them.

items.title: Search and measurement foundations
items.body: Website packages include page-level metadata, internal structure, crawlable pages, sitemap setup and technical search foundations. Starter includes basic Google Analytics setup, while Growth also includes Google Business Profile setup or configuration support, subject to access, consent and verified business details.

items.title: Content management where included
items.body: Starter and Growth include a configured editing interface for agreed text and image fields. It can be added to Foundation or scoped for a Custom project.

items.title: Testing, launch and handover
items.body: Once the approved scope is built, we test the website across the supported range, complete final checks and launch when the agreed work is ready. The handover covers the relevant website information and agreed editing guidance.

sections.title: Start with the size and depth of the website.
sections.body: Foundation suits a focused online presence. Starter supports more services or content. Growth is for broader structures, deeper content or agreed integrations. Custom covers work that does not fit a standard page range or feature set.

sections.title: SEO starts differently depending on the website.

items.title: SEO foundations in a new Horizon Digital website
items.body: Foundation, Starter and Growth include page-level metadata, internal structure, crawlable pages, sitemap setup and technical search foundations. These elements help search engines access and understand the website, but they do not guarantee a position in search results.

items.title: SEO review for an existing or third-party website
items.body: A redesign is not required. We can review the website and explain its technical and on-page SEO priorities. You can use the recommendations yourself, share them with your existing provider or ask us to quote for the changes.

sections.title: Review and recommendations are one service. Implementation is another.

items.title: Review and recommendations
items.body: We examine the technical and on-page areas included in the review, explain what we find and identify what to address first. The recommendations are yours to use internally or share with another provider.

items.title: Separately scoped implementation
items.body: If you want Horizon Digital to make the changes, we confirm that work separately. What we can implement depends on the website platform, the access available and any process controlled by an existing provider.

sections.note: Standalone review and implementation work is scoped after an initial discussion.

sections.title: Set up useful website measurement.
sections.body: We can configure the agreed website measurement so you can understand basic visitor activity. Before implementation, we confirm the website and account access together with the consent setup chosen for the business.
sections.note: This service does not imply an advanced dashboard, attribution model, recurring analysis or a guaranteed business outcome. The written scope confirms the measurement setup included.
sections.support: Basic Google Analytics setup is included in Starter. Growth also includes Google Business Profile setup or configuration support when the required access, consent setup and verified details are available.

sections.title: Keep the profile accurate and under your control.
sections.body: We can help set up a Google Business Profile or improve an existing profile using accurate business information and the features available to that business. Work depends on the necessary profile access, authority and verified business details.
sections.note: The business profile should remain under the client's ownership and control. Google controls verification and feature availability, so those steps cannot be guaranteed or bypassed.

sections.body: You may need analytics setup, Google Business Profile support or an initial discussion covering both areas. The written scope keeps the accounts, access requirements and deliverables clear.

faqs.question: How much does a website cost?
faqs.answer: Packages start at SCR 7,500 for Foundation, SCR 12,500 for Starter and SCR 25,000 for Growth. Custom work is scoped separately. The written proposal confirms the final price.

faqs.question: What is included in the price?
faqs.answer: The package lists the included page range, design, responsive development, contact options, SEO foundations, revisions and post-launch support. The written scope records any project-specific additions or exclusions.

faqs.question: How long does a project take?
faqs.answer: Many standard projects take around 3 to 6 weeks. Scope, content readiness, feedback and integrations can change the timeline, so the proposal includes a project-specific estimate.

faqs.question: Do I own the website and domain?
faqs.answer: The final approved website files and assets transfer as agreed when the project closes. The domain remains in the client's registrar account. Third-party licences and services remain subject to their own terms.

faqs.question: Can I update the website myself?
faqs.answer: Content management is included in Starter and Growth for agreed fields, can be added to Foundation, and can be scoped for Custom projects. Horizon Digital can also handle later updates.

faqs.question: Is support included after launch?
faqs.answer: Foundation includes 30 days, Starter 45 days and Growth 60 days of post-launch support. Custom support is defined in the proposal.

faqs.question: Can you guarantee Google rankings or business results?
faqs.answer: No. Horizon Digital provides technical and on-page SEO foundations and builds clear contact paths, but search rankings, traffic, enquiries, bookings and revenue depend on factors outside the website build and are not guaranteed.

faqs.question: How do I get started?
faqs.answer: Use the contact page or WhatsApp link to share your business, goals, current website, preferred timeline and approximate budget. Horizon Digital aims to reply within 24 hours.

items.question: What kind of websites do you build?
items.answer: Custom business websites and redesigns focused on clear information, responsive use, performance and straightforward enquiry paths.

items.question: Can you add payments or bookings?
items.answer: Payment, booking and enquiry integrations can be scoped when the required provider supports the business and the necessary account access is available.

items.question: Do you help with content?
items.answer: Yes. Page structure and messaging guidance are included, and page content writing is available as an add-on.

items.question: What is a typical timeline?
items.answer: Many standard projects take around 3 to 6 weeks. The proposal confirms the estimate for your scope.

items.question: How many revisions are included?
items.answer: Foundation includes one revision round. Starter and Growth include two. Custom revision terms are confirmed in the proposal.

items.question: How involved do I need to be?
items.answer: You provide business information and content, review milestone drafts and approve the direction. Horizon Digital handles the design and technical work.

items.question: Can I update the website myself?
items.answer: Content management is included in Starter and Growth for agreed fields, can be added to Foundation, and can be scoped for Custom projects.

items.question: What support is provided after launch?

items.question: What if I need help later?
items.answer: Later changes can be quoted separately or covered through an agreed ongoing support arrangement.

items.question: Do I own the website?
items.answer: The final approved website files and assets transfer as agreed when the project closes. The domain remains in your registrar account.

items.question: Can you help with business email?
items.answer: Business email setup can be scoped using a suitable email provider and an address on your domain.

items.question: Where is my website hosted?
